details.description:
Fevistik is a super convenient format that makes pasting a non-messy, non-staining job. Hassle-free and easy to use, Fevistick made sticking clean and convenient through its innovative rotary gluestick form. It is easy to carry, comes in a pocket-friendly size wherever you go, you are covered for all your adhesive needs. Through its unique rotary gluestick form, Fevistick makes sticking quick, easy, and hassle-free
Fevistik comes with a fast-drying formula that provides an instant solution to all of your paper-to-paper glueing requirements. Apart from the rotational opening and easy to apply functionality, this glue stick provides you with a smooth and hassle-free experience. Fevistik is safe to use for all age groups.

Discover the ultimate crafting companion with Fevistik Power, the versatile glue stick that effortlessly bonds a wide range of materials. Designed to simplify the creative process for kids, this non-messy adhesive enables them to complete their projects independently, fostering a sense of confidence and unleashing their artistic flair. From securing mirrors, sequins, and synthetic flowers to firmly attaching wooden buttons and jute, this innovative glue stick is the solution for all your crafting needs. Offering a convenient, mess-free application, Fevistik Power empowers children to explore their creativity without the hassle, ensuring a rewarding and enriching learning experience. Unlock the joy of independent crafting and let your child's imagination soar with this exceptional adhesive.

Experience the joy of mess-free crafting with the Fevistik Rockin' Roller! This easy-to-use adhesive roller ensures a smooth, precise application on the edges, without any paper wrinkling. Ideal for scrapbooking, card making, gift wrapping, and a variety of other creative projects, the Rockin' Roller provides 8 metres of usage, making your crafting experience exciting and enjoyable. Designed to apply adhesive smoothly on edges, this versatile tool helps you achieve clean, professional-looking results every time, allowing you to focus on the creative process and have fun.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Apply adhesive by rolling. Hold the side as it is mentioned in the image.
2. Roll towards yourself.
3. Stick.
